an6.56:1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā phagguṇo ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
an6.56:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.56:1.3: āyasmā bhante phagguṇo ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
an6.56:1.4: sādhu bhante bhagavā yenāyasmā phagguṇo tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an6.56:1.6: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā phagguṇo tenupasaṅkami
an6.56:1.7: addasā kho āyasmā phagguṇo bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
an6.56:1.9: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ phagguṇaṃ etadavoca
an6.56:1.10: alaṃ phagguṇa mā tvaṃ mañcake samañcopi
an6.56:1.11: santimāni āsanāni parehi paññattāni tatthāhaṃ nisīdissāmīti
an6.56:1.13: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ phagguṇaṃ etadavoca
an6.56:2.1: kacci te phagguṇa khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
an6.56:2.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo
an6.56:3.1: seyyathāpi bhante balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani abhimaṭṭheyya evameva kho bhante adhimattā vātā muddhani ohananti
an6.56:3.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo
an6.56:4.1: seyyathāpi bhante balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhandhena sīse sīsaveṭhanaṃ dadeyya evameva kho bhante adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā
an6.56:4.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo
an6.56:5.1: seyyathāpi bhante dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya evameva kho me bhante adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti
an6.56:5.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo
an6.56:6.1: seyyathāpi bhante dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ evameva kho bhante adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho
an6.56:6.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
an6.56:6.3: athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ phagguṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi
an6.56:7.1: atha kho āyasmā phagguṇo acirapakkantassa bhagavato kālamakāsi
an6.56:7.2: tamhi cassa samaye maraṇakāle indriyāni vippasīdiṃsu.
an6.56:7.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.56:7.4: āyasmā bhante phagguṇo acirapakkantassa bhagavato kālamakāsi
an6.56:7.5: tamhi cassa samaye maraṇakāle indriyāni vippasīdiṃsūti.
an6.56:8.1: kiṃ hānanda phagguṇassa bhikkhuno indriyāni na vippasīdissanti
an6.56:8.2: phagguṇassa ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ ahosi
an6.56:8.3: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ
an6.56:9.1: chayime ānanda ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavane kālena atthupaparikkhāya
an6.56:9.3: idhānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti
an6.56:9.4: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya
an6.56:9.5: tassa tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
an6.56:9.6: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati
an6.56:9.7: ayaṃ ānanda paṭhamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavane.
an6.56:10.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti
an6.56:10.2: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle naheva kho labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya api ca kho tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya
an6.56:10.3: tassa tathāgatasāvako dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
an6.56:10.4: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati
an6.56:10.5: ayaṃ ānanda dutiyo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavane.
